name: 风之璐璐薇
who: Luluwe, the goddess of wind, walking the world as a strikingly beautiful free-spirited young woman who looks about twenty-five, 176 cm, slender and long-legged. A wild, wind-tossed mane of long golden hair, sharp emerald-green eyes, a teasing, haughty smile of someone who enjoys making others kneel, playful and dangerous at once. White feathers drift around her, and a great longbow wrapped in swirling wind is never far from her hand.
palette: white, pale gold, sky blue, a touch of black feathers
casual: A free traveller and archer: a fitted white sleeveless top under a short sky-blue riding jacket, close-fitting dark trousers, tall white boots, a quiver on the hip, the wind-wrapped longbow resting on her shoulder, a scarf and a few white feathers fluttering. Hand on hip, head tilted, a teasing smirk.
private: Off the road: a loose white shirt with rolled sleeves tucked into dark trousers, barefoot-looking comfortable sandals, hair loose and tangled by the wind, lounging with a bottle of strong liquor in one hand, laughing.
formal: As a goddess: a long flowing white gown layered with pale gold, covered by a sheer gauzy shawl of white silk that streams in the wind (her divine wind-wrap), white feathered pauldrons, the great longbow in hand surrounded by visible spiralling wind, a small black-winged angel familiar perched on her shoulder. Fully and elegantly dressed; the sheer silk is an outer shawl only.
art: A large close portrait: golden hair whipping across her face, emerald eyes half-lidded with a haughty, teasing smile, one finger lifted to her lips. Bright sky light and wind streaks; foreground blur of white feathers.

name: 大地之欧巴德斯
who: Obadus, the god of earth, walking the world as a huge man of 211 cm, broad as a city wall, with a face that looks chiselled from stone and the weary calm of someone who has set down a heavy armour. Long, thick wild black hair with a dark blue sheen. Warm bronze skin on his face and neck, warm red-iron coloured eyes, a small calm slightly amused smile. His hands are enormous and scarred with old work. He moves quietly for his size and the ground around him is still. Gentle, patient, but with a fighter's readiness in how he stands.
palette: granite grey, bronze, iron red, deep umber
casual: A long, heavy coat of undyed brown wool cut like a labourer's work coat, closing down the front with big horn buttons, fitted sleeves, a wide leather belt, dark trousers and heavy boots with iron toe caps; a rough sack slung on one shoulder. No weapon. Standing square and still, hands loosely open at his sides.
private: Off duty: a plain wool tunic with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, a worn leather apron, bare forearms of warm bronze skin, heavy boots; the black hair tied low at the back. A heavy cup in one big hand. Standing easy with the weight on one leg.
formal: As a god at his shrine: a long surcoat of deep slate grey with gold trim and a gold collar, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, over a dark tunic; a gold ring on the chest; one shoulder and arm of rough grey granite with thin ember-gold seams. The great earth hammer, dark iron stone with gold bands, held upright in one hand. A faint thin halo of gold.
art: A large close portrait of the broad calm face, black hair with a blue sheen falling forward, warm red-iron eyes, a slight smile. Amber light from the left, cool grey from the right. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and a few grains of gold.

name: 元素之伊兹帕鲁特
who: Izparute, the god of elements, walking the world as a proud red-haired duke who looks about forty and ageless, 187 cm, tall and broad-shouldered with a commanding bearing. Long thick crimson hair swept back from a high forehead, sharp amber-gold eyes, a strong handsome face with a stern, lordly, slightly condescending look of a ruler who calls himself the chief of all gods. A faint memory of five-coloured light plays over him, flame-red, frost-blue, storm-violet, leaf-green and gold.
palette: deep crimson, black, gold, with five-colour iridescent accents (red, ice blue, violet, green, gold)
casual: A nobleman travelling incognito: a long black frock coat with gold trim over a dark crimson waistcoat and white shirt with a cravat, riding gloves, tall black boots, an ancient leather-bound grimoire under one arm. Chin raised, looking down his nose.
private: At leisure in his study: a long crimson dressing gown over shirt and trousers, sitting back as if on a throne-like chair is implied by his pose but drawn standing, a glass of red wine in one hand and an old scroll in the other, a faint satisfied smirk.
formal: As a god and duke: a magnificent long crimson ducal coat embroidered with gold flame and frost motifs, black breeches and boots, a heavy black-and-gold mantle whose lining shimmers in five colours, and two great folded wings of light behind him, one wreathed in flame and one in freezing frost. A gold circlet on his brow. One hand raised in a commanding gesture with a small sphere of elemental light above the palm. Western cut: plain round buttons, no frog-knot fasteners, no mandarin collar.
art: A large close portrait: the proud handsome face framed by long crimson hair, amber-gold eyes looking down at the viewer with regal disdain and a hint of old sorrow. Warm firelight from one side, icy blue rim light from the other; foreground blur of drifting embers and frost sparkles.

name: 收获之库米罗妮
who: Kumiromi, the goddess of harvest, walking the world as a quiet slight woman of about thirty, 168 cm in her human guise, who walks last in any group and does not speak. A young face with a calm, old, kind gaze, never cute, never childish. Short wheat-gold hair at chin length tied back with a straw cord, one small braid. A white ash-wood staff in her hand with a green vine winding around it. She looks once at the grain in a store and goes on.
palette: wheat gold, moss green, ash white, straw
casual: A plain moss green wool tunic with long fitted sleeves over a pale linen shift, closing at the neck with a button, a brown wool skirt, a cloth satchel on a strap, sturdy boots; the straw cord in her hair. The white ash staff carried in one hand. Walking, quiet, eyes lowered.
private: Resting: a loose pale linen dress with long fitted sleeves, a knitted green shawl, bare head with the short hair loose, soft shoes. She holds a small apple and the staff leans in the crook of her arm. A gentle closed-mouth smile.
formal: As a goddess: a moss green tunic over a white linen shift, living green vines with small leaves wrapped around her arms, shoulders and waist; a pair of small young pale antlers budding from her hair and a thin flat ring of a dozen softly glowing golden seeds floating above her head. The slender scythe with a pale steel blade and thin gold edge held upright beside her.
art: A large close portrait of the young face with the old quiet gaze, wheat-gold hair, a ring of tiny golden seeds above. Warm gold late-afternoon light from the right, cool green shade on the left. Foreground blur: wheat ears and floating seeds.

name: 幸运之艾赫卡托尔
who: Ehekatl, the goddess of luck, walking the world as a young woman of about twenty-five, 165 cm, light on her feet, fishing from a riverbank with a black cat at her feet. Long wavy pale golden hair, a small black ribbon with a gold bell tied at the side of her head, big bright sky blue eyes, a sly cheerful closed-mouth smile with one corner turned up and one thin eyebrow lifted. A tiny gold bell also on a cord at her throat. Mischievous, quick, always about to get away with something.
palette: pale gold, sky blue, black cat black, bell gold
casual: A short riverside jacket of faded blue wool over a white linen shirt, closing down the front with mismatched buttons, fitted sleeves, a dark skirt to the knee with stockings and old boots; the black ribbon and gold bell in her hair. She holds a simple fishing rod in one hand, a small gold coin turning between the fingers of the other. A sly smile.
private: Relaxed: an oversized white wool sweater with long sleeves, a plain skirt, soft shoes, the golden hair loose with the black ribbon. She holds a gold coin up to look at it. A grin, the eyebrow raised.
formal: As a goddess: a soft light white dress with thin gold trim and fitted sleeves, a slim gold-hilted dagger tucked into the sash, the black ribbon and bell, long pale golden hair flowing; one large gold coin spinning in the air above her raised hand, struck with a grinning cat face in low relief. A faint thin halo of gold sparks.
art: A large close portrait, a half smile and one raised eyebrow, sky blue eyes following a spinning gold coin held in the foreground. Bright warm light from the right, soft shadow on the left. Foreground blur: the coin and golden sparks.

name: 治愈之朱亚
who: Jure, the goddess of healing, walking the world as a small, slight young woman of about twenty-six, 151 cm, in coarse working clothes, who looks first at your breathing and then at your wound. Long soft wavy spring green hair, often tucked behind her shoulders, two small white feathers in it. Clear jade green eyes, calm and a little lifted, a gentle firm manner. A faded cloth satchel of herbs and bandages always at her side. Quiet, unhurried, with steady hands.
palette: jade green, white feather, rose pink, plain linen
casual: A coarse undyed linen working dress with long fitted sleeves, high at the neck, closing down the front with wooden buttons, an apron over it, a rolled bandage at the belt, sturdy shoes; two small white feathers in her spring green hair. A cloth satchel of herbs on one shoulder. Standing gently, hands folded in front.
private: Resting: a soft rose-pink knitted cardigan over a pale linen dress, long sleeves, the green hair loose past her waist, soft slippers. She holds a cup of herb tea in both hands. A tired, kind half smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long white and soft rose pink robe with a wide cape in big flat folds, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a gold four-pointed star on the cape; a pair of tiny white feathered wings rising from her hair, five or six white feathers drifting. The holy lance, a slim white and rose-gold shaft with a leaf-shaped spearhead, held upright in both hands in front of her. A faint thin halo.
art: A large close portrait, the small gentle face with jade eyes looking just past the viewer, feathers in the green hair. Soft white light from the left, a warm rose glow from the right. Foreground blur: drifting white feathers and a rolled bandage.

name: 战祸之耶万
who: Yewan, the god of war, walking the world as a slender man who looks about thirty, 178 cm and lightly built, in plain simple robes. He wears thin round wire-rimmed spectacles and has a clean old scar running down through his left eye, which stays closed; the right eye is a calm grey. Neat short ash-brown hair, a gentle, polite, faintly smiling face that looks harmless and somehow untrustworthy at the same time, the kind of courteous man who cheers a battle like a game. He carries his war-god's weapon, a brutal heavy blade far too savage for his mild look.
palette: undyed off-white, ash grey, faded slate blue, dark leather, a little old steel
casual: A plain long robe of undyed off-white linen belted with a simple cloth belt, a faded slate-blue outer robe open over it, plain trousers and travel boots. Spectacles on, left eye scarred shut. Hands folded politely in front of him, head tilted with a mild smile.
private: Off duty: a simple loose shirt and soft trousers, the outer robe hanging over one shoulder, spectacles pushed up, holding an open dog-eared book of battle reports in one hand and a cup of tea in the other, smiling at something on the page.
formal: As a god: a long simple robe of ash-grey wool with a plain darker overrobe, no ornament but a thin worn leather strap across the chest, a faint thin halo of cold white light. He rests both hands on the pommel of a huge brutal two-handed blade planted point-down before him, its edge notched and savage, in strong contrast to his mild smiling face behind the spectacles. Western cut: plain round buttons, no frog-knot fasteners, no mandarin collar.
art: A large close portrait: the mild face with round spectacles catching the light, the scar down the closed left eye, a polite smile that does not reach the open grey eye. Soft grey light, a thin cold rim light; foreground blur of a drifting robe edge and a glint of notched steel.

name: 破晓之风莉尤
who: Liyu, the goddess of morning wind, walking the world as a young woman of about twenty-three, 163 cm, slim and quick, a porter who sets out before it is light. Hair the pale gold of the first line of dawn at the edge of a cloud, tied low at the neck. Light blue eyes, a bright eager face. A string of tiny pale shells around her ankle that clicks when she runs. She is always in a hurry and cannot sit for long.
palette: dawn pale gold, light blue, shell white, soft peach
casual: A porter's grey-brown coarse wool jacket closing down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, a short skirt over trousers and laced boots, a curved wooden shoulder yoke of the European milkmaid kind, shaped around the back of her neck, with a lidded wooden pail hanging from each end on short chains; the string of tiny pale shells at her ankle. A bright, hurried look, mid stride.
private: Resting: an oversized undyed wool sweater with long sleeves, trousers rolled at the ankle, bare feet with the string of shells, hair loose. She holds a warm bun in both hands. A sleepy half smile.
formal: As a goddess at the altar: a long dawn-pale gown with fitted sleeves and a short pink-gold cape, closing down the front, light as mist, the string of shells at the ankle, hair pale gold flowing; one hand lifted as if parting a cloud. A faint thin halo of dawn light.
art: A large close portrait, the bright young face lit from behind by a thin line of dawn gold, light blue eyes eager. Soft peach light from the left, cool blue shade on the right. Foreground blur: drifting mist and tiny shells.

name: 破晓之风莉尤

palette: dawn pale gold, light blue, shell white, soft peach

private: Resting: a loose cream linen shirt, grey wool trousers and soft boots, the goggles hanging at her neck, hair loose. A mug of hot tea in both hands. A sleepy smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long dawn-pale coat-gown cut close and fitted with a fan of pink-gold pleats, closing down the front with brass clasps, the shells at her ankle, pale gold hair streaming; one hand lifted as if parting a cloud. art: A large close portrait, the bright young face lit from behind by a thin line of dawn gold, light blue eyes eager. Soft peach light from the left, cool blue shade on the right. Foreground blur: drifting mist and tiny shells.

name: 千骑之首瑞恩达尔
who: Rendal, the god of horses and the hunt, walking the world as a very tall lean man of about forty, 192 cm, a huntsman of the north. Long wind-blown pale hair tied back, a calm keen face, grey eyes that watch the snow. A trace of frost on his beard. Where he walks the snow shows long lines of paw prints but no dogs. He carries a hunting horn at his side and a long bow, and horses go still for him.
palette: snow white, silver, storm blue-grey, pale gold
casual: A northern huntsman's mantle of white-maned wild horse hide worn over the shoulders with the horse's head as a hood: a long equine muzzle, a white mane and small upright horse ears, clearly a horse and never a wolf, thrown back, over a dark grey wool tunic closing down the front with bone buttons, fitted sleeves, leather breeches and fur-lined boots; a curled pale horn at his hip, a long wooden bow in one hand. Standing tall and watchful.
private: Resting: the horsehide mantle hung from one shoulder, a plain wool tunic with sleeves pushed up, soft boots, pale hair loose. The bow leans against his shoulder, a hand resting on the head of an unseen dog. A calm half smile.
formal: As a god: the white-maned horse-hide mantle with the horse's head as a hood: a long equine muzzle, a white mane and small upright horse ears, clearly a horse and never a wolf, glowing faintly with starlight over a light silver breastplate engraved with galloping horses, glowing hunting marks on the hems, a curled pale gold hunting horn; a great longbow of soft pale gold light in his hand; behind his head a thin ring of galloping horses made of light.
art: A large close portrait, the keen grey eyes looking over the viewer's shoulder, frost on the white mane of the horse's-head hood, its long equine muzzle above his brow. Cold blue-white light from the left, a pale gold glint on the right. Foreground blur: falling snow and faint paw prints in snow.

name: 群翼的牧童塔兰迦
who: Taranka, the goddess of migrating birds, walking the world as a slim adult woman of about twenty-five, 158 cm, a goose-keeper who watches the sky. Frost-white long hair worn in a loose plait, amber eyes, a patient face that counts the geese passing overhead one by one with her lips moving. A white feather caught in her hair, and her coat has small white feathers stuck in the lining. Quiet, watchful, a little shy.
palette: frost white, amber, grey goose feather, straw
casual: A goose-keeper's short wool coat of undyed grey, closing down the front with wooden toggles, fitted sleeves, a long brown skirt, a woven shawl and boots; a long thin switch in her hand and white feathers stuck in the band of a soft cap. Looking up, one hand shading her eyes.
private: Resting: a loose cream wool sweater with long sleeves, a plain skirt, soft felt boots, the white hair unbound. She holds a single white feather up to the light. A small shy smile.
formal: As a goddess: a pure white long gown with fitted sleeves and a white feathered cloak, closing down the front, light pale gold trim; a pair of white wings folded at her back, the tips trailing to her heels. A white shepherd's crook in one hand. A faint thin halo of white feathers.
art: A large close portrait, the amber eyes lifted to a flock of birds above the frame, white hair blowing. Cold silver light from the left, a warm amber rim on the right. Foreground blur: drifting white feathers and distant geese.

name: 满帆之手欧希拉
who: Ohira, the goddess of the voyager's fair wind, walking the world as a tall woman of about thirty-five, 178 cm, a sailmaker mending canvas on the quay. Bare strong forearms, wide palms with thick calluses, sun-bleached pale flax hair tied with a strip of sailcloth, sea-teal eyes. A weathered, patient, kind face. She smells of tar and salt. Plain-spoken, steady, the kind of person ships are handed to.
palette: sea teal, canvas cream, tar black, bleached flax
casual: A sailmaker's sleeveless leather jerkin over a rolled-sleeve linen shirt, closing down the front with toggles, canvas trousers, bare strong forearms, heavy boots; a sailmaker's palm strap on one hand and a long needle through the sailcloth strip in her hair. A coil of rope on one shoulder. Standing solid, weight low.
private: Resting: a loose grey wool jersey with sleeves pushed up, canvas trousers rolled at the ankle, barefoot, the flax hair unbound. A tin cup of hot tea in one wide hand. A slow warm smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long sea-teal coat-gown cut like a ship captain's coat, closing down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves with canvas-pale cuffs, the wide hands bare; one palm held open and upward as if filling a sail, a thin pale gold halo behind her head like a full sail.
art: A large close portrait, the weathered kind face turned a little into the wind, sea-teal eyes squinting, one wide palm raised at the edge of the frame. Warm low sun from the right, cool sea-blue shade on the left. Foreground blur: salt spray and a loose bit of sailcloth.

name: 未落之箭卡瑟蕾
who: Casarel, the goddess of the bow, walking the world as a lean woman of about thirty-two, 174 cm, a hunter of the northern country. Red-copper short hair cut to the ears, eyes the green-blue of autumn lake water. Her left hand is always half closed as if holding a bow that is not there, and an arrowhead earring hangs from her right ear (on the viewer's left when they face us). Watchful, patient, with a steady calm look that waits for someone to hold their breath.
palette: red copper, lake green, wool grey, arrowhead steel
casual: A northern hunter's fur-lined short coat of grey-brown wool, closing down the front with bone toggles, fitted sleeves, a leather belt with a quiver on the back, trousers and tall boots, a small knife at the belt. The left hand half closed at her side, a small arrowhead earring in the right ear (on the viewer's left when they face us). Standing very still, eyes on the middle distance.
private: Resting: a loose undyed wool shirt, the coat hung over a shoulder, soft boots, sleeves pushed up. She holds a dry arrow shaft between her fingers and tests its line with one eye. A quiet half smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long dark green hunter's coat-gown with silver trim, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a high collar; a long bow of pale wood and silver held in her left hand with the string drawn lightly and an arrow ready, not loosed. A faint thin halo of pale light.
art: A large close portrait, the copper hair at the ear, an arrowhead earring, a steady green-blue gaze just past the lens. Cold clear light from the left, a rust glow on the right. Foreground blur: a single arrow tip held near the lens and drifting snow.

name: 隘口的呼啸瓦尔缇
who: Valti, the goddess of the high mountain passes and the wind above the snow line, walking the world as a very tall woman of about thirty-five, 185 cm, the keeper of a fire in a pass. Long ice-blue hair in a single thick braid whose tip always drifts toward the pass, eyes the green of glacier ice. A faint whistle in her voice when she talks. A steady, hardy, quiet presence.
palette: ice blue, glacier green, snow white, fur brown
casual: A mountain fire-keeper's heavy sheepskin coat with the wool turned inward, closing down the front with bone toggles, fitted sleeves, thick wool trousers, fur-lined boots and mittens, a scarf at the neck; a long staff with an iron fire-pot hook in one hand. The ice-blue braid hangs over one shoulder. Standing upright against the wind.
private: Resting: a thick knitted blue wool sweater with long sleeves, wool trousers, fur boots, the braid undone and brushed loose. She holds a hot mug near her face, steam rising. A calm half smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long pale blue-white coat-gown with fur-trimmed collar and cuffs, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, silver wind-pattern embroidery; the long ice-blue braid streaming sideways as if in a gale. A pale iron fire-pot staff held upright. A faint thin halo of frost.
art: A large close portrait, the braid tip blowing across the frame, glacier-green eyes narrowed against the wind. Cold bright blue light from the left, a tiny warm firelight on the right. Foreground blur: blowing snow.

name: 卷云弥尔瓦
who: Mirva, the goddess of whirlwind and storm, walking the world as a broad-shouldered woman sailor of about thirty-eight, 180 cm, soaked to the skin. Her hair is rolled in thick curls like cloud and is always wet, dark grey-white at the roots and pale at the tips. A deep, easy voice that sounds a little like distant thunder. Grey-green eyes, a weatherbeaten laughing face. Restless, boisterous, impatient.
palette: storm grey, cloud white, sea green, wet slate
casual: A sailor's heavy tarred canvas coat closing down the front with toggles, fitted sleeves, wet thick wool trousers, sea boots, a coil of rope over one shoulder; her hair in wet thick curls under a knitted cap. Hands on hips, a rolling stance as if on a deck.
private: Resting: a salt-stiff wool jersey, loose trousers, bare feet, the hair left to dry in big curls. A tankard in one hand, the other waving something away. A loud, easy grin.
formal: As a goddess: a long storm-grey and white coat-gown with a high collar, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a wide cape that billows; her cloud-curled hair rolled high into a crown of storm cloud. A faint thin halo of wheeling cloud and a distant flicker of lightning. No cloud-scroll or swirl embroidery anywhere; plain hem trim.
art: A large close portrait, wet curls whipped across the cheek, a laughing mouth, grey-green eyes bright. Cold side light from the left, a flicker of white-blue on the right. Foreground blur: spray and rain drops.

name: 第一口气与最后一口气塞维娅
who: Sevia, the goddess of the first breath and the last, walking the world as a young woman of about twenty-six, 168 cm, calm and quiet, with a face that gives no age. Very long undone dark hair that reaches her waist, a pale composed face. Wherever she stands the lamp flame bends lower as she exhales and stands up again as she inhales; no snow settles on her, no ash sticks to her. She sits with the sick and with the newly born. Gentle, patient, unhurried.
palette: undyed linen cream, pale grey, flame amber, dark hair
casual: A plain gown of undyed natural linen, long fitted sleeves, high at the neck, closing down the front with small cloth buttons, an unbleached wool shawl, soft shoes; the very long dark hair left unbound. Hands loosely folded in front, standing quietly.
private: Resting: a looser, softer undyed linen gown with long sleeves down to the ankles, a knitted shawl, bare feet, the hair unbound. She holds a small lamp whose flame leans away from her breath. A faint soft smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long gown of the same undyed linen, now fine and white, closing down the front, long fitted sleeves, a pale grey shawl over the shoulders, the long dark hair flowing; a thin, almost invisible halo of warm breath-mist behind her head. Both hands open at her chest.
art: A large close portrait, a pale quiet face with eyes half closed, a candle flame in the foreground leaning away. Dim warm lamp light from the right, soft grey from the left. Foreground blur: a candle and a thread of pale mist.

name: 空笼与断缰之主阿科洛
who: Acoro, the goddess of freedom and escape, walking the world as a young woman of about twenty-four, 165 cm, a fish-keeper at the river who lets the fish go. Messy tangled black hair, bright dark eyes, a laugh like someone who has just got away. A cut length of old leather rein wrapped around her wrist, a faint pale ring on each ankle where chains once were, the hem of her skirt always wet. Barefoot, quick, restless.
palette: black hair, river wet grey, leather brown, free white
casual: A river-keeper's plain wool jacket closing down the front with wooden buttons, fitted sleeves, a long wet-hemmed skirt, a cut leather rein wound around her wrist, bare feet with pale marks at the ankles. A wicker fish basket slung at her side. Walking quickly, glancing back.
private: Resting: a loose cream linen shirt, a woollen skirt, bare feet, the black hair left tangled. She holds a small silver fish in cupped hands, about to let it go. A wide sly smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long dark river-grey coat-gown closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a ragged hem; in her upraised hands a broken chain whose links glow faintly, the cut leather rein around her wrist. A faint thin halo of broken chain links.
art: A large close portrait, a bright dark-eyed laugh with tangled black hair across the cheek, a cut rein at the wrist in the foreground. Cool daylight from the left, a golden flare on the right. Foreground blur: a hanging broken chain and sparkles of river water.

palette: black hair, river wet grey, leather brown, free white
casual: A patched dark wool road jacket closing down the front with mismatched buttons, fitted sleeves, trousers, battered boots, a faded blue wool cloak ankle-length thrown over one shoulder, a cut leather rein wound around her wrist. Walking quickly, glancing back.
private: Resting: a loose old linen shirt, trousers, bare feet with pale marks at the ankles. She holds a small padlock whose shackle is open. A wide sly smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long patched dark coat-gown closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a ragged hem; in her upraised hands a broken chain whose links glow faintly. A faint thin halo of broken chain links.
art: A large close portrait, a bright dark-eyed laugh with tangled black hair across the cheek, a cut rein at the wrist in the foreground. Cool daylight from the left, a golden flare on the right. Foreground blur: a hanging broken chain and sparkles of river water.

name: 擎山者多尔加恩
who: Dolgaen, the god of mountains and foundations, walking the world as a very tall, thick-shouldered man of about fifty, 205 cm, who looks like a small hill when he sits down. Heavy square shoulders, a broad quiet face, grey-brown short hair and a short grey beard. Snow tends to settle on his shoulders when he sits and he never brushes it off; the ground under him is solid. Slow-moving, few words, mild.
palette: slate grey, snow white, granite brown, iron
casual: A heavy hooded cloak of thick undyed grey wool worn over a dark wool tunic closing down the front with big iron buttons, fitted sleeves, wide leather belt, heavy trousers and boots; a thin dusting of snow on the shoulders. No weapon. Standing like a pillar, hands loosely at his sides.
private: Resting: a coarse knitted brown wool sweater, rolled sleeves, heavy trousers, soft boots; a mug in one big hand. Snow lying on the shoulders unbrushed. A slow quiet smile.
formal: As a god: a long surcoat of dark slate wool with silver-grey stone-pattern embroidery, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a cape of heavy snow-white wool across both shoulders heaped with a thin layer of snow; a plain iron stone mace-staff held upright. A faint thin halo of white snow light.
art: A large close portrait, the broad quiet face, snow on the shoulders and the hair. Cold white light from the left, a low warm grey from the right. Foreground blur: slow falling snow and a stone edge.

name: 岩中金的守秘人古伦贝
who: Gulumbe, the god of ores and metals hidden in stone, walking the world as a stocky old dwarf miner of about two hundred and eighty, 130 cm, with a broad chest and hands full of stone dust. Thick grey beard braided with a bit of copper wire, small keen eyes the colour of wet slate, a deep voice. A cracked wicker ore basket on his back; he taps on a rock face and knows what lies behind it. Dwarves take him for one of their own, and he does not say otherwise.
palette: slate grey, copper, gold ore, stone dust
casual: A dwarf miner's thick leather jerkin over a coarse wool shirt with rolled sleeves, a heavy leather apron, short trousers with knee pads and iron-shod boots; a broken-mouthed ore basket on his back and a small rock hammer at the belt. Tapping a rock face with the hammer's handle, head tilted to listen.
private: Resting: a patched wool shirt with sleeves rolled, braces over it, felt slippers, the basket set aside. A clay pipe, unlit, between his teeth and a lump of ore cupped in one hand. A satisfied half smile.
formal: As a god: a fine tunic of deep grey wool with seams of gold thread laid like veins of ore, closing down the front with gold buttons, a heavy dark leather mantle with a gold clasp, the beard bound with gold rings; a raw lump of gold-streaked stone in one hand. A faint thin halo of gold dust.
art: A large close portrait, the grey braided beard, narrow slate-grey eyes listening to the rock, stone dust in the air. Warm gold lantern light from the left, a cold grey rim on the right. Foreground blur: sparkling gold dust and a rough ore chunk.

name: 万钧之主赫斯陶
who: Hestao, the god of strength and carrying weight, walking the world as a very tall, very old man, 200 cm, with a back bowed by loads, a porter of the high roads. Hands as wide as a door; a deep-lined silent face, white shoulder-length hair, pale eyes. He talks only to sheep. Before lifting anything he puts one hand flat on the ground; others have copied the gesture without knowing from whom.
palette: ox leather brown, hemp grey, bone white, weathered iron
casual: A porter's thick hemp-brown wool coat, closing down the front with heavy toggles, fitted sleeves, wide leather harness straps crossing the chest, patched trousers and heavy boots; a rope coil at the belt. Bowed under no load, one hand held low as if about to press the ground. Western tailoring: plain round buttons in a straight row or lacing, no frog-knot fasteners, no knotted closures and no mandarin collar. The coat closes with a wide leather belt and two plain round buttons only: no toggles, no loops, no bar fasteners across the chest.
private: Resting: a worn wool tunic with the sleeves pushed up, harness off and hung beside him, soft boots. A tin cup in one huge hand, the other hand lying flat on the ground beside him. A slow patient smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of heavy dark brown wool with bronze trim, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, wide shoulder cape; harness straps studded with bronze rings crossing the chest; one huge bare hand spread flat, palm down. A faint thin halo of dust.
art: A large close portrait, the deeply lined silent face and white hair, pale eyes steady. Warm amber light from the left, dusty grey from the right. Foreground blur: a rope end and falling dust.

name: 河心的坐石莫兰特
who: Morant, the goddess of bridges and fords, walking the world as a ferrywoman of no certain age, about thirty, 170 cm, barefoot, whose clothes are always the colour of river water and always damp. Dark wet-looking hair to the shoulder, a calm river-grey face and eyes. Water parts around her feet and joins again behind. When she studies a bridge, the wind on it stops for a moment. Quiet, patient, observant.
palette: river grey-green, wet slate, wet stone brown, white foam
casual: A ferrywoman's river-grey wool coat, damp, closing down the front with wooden buttons, fitted sleeves, a long skirt tucked up at the hip, bare feet, a coiled rope over one shoulder and a long punting pole in one hand. Standing steady.
private: Resting: a loose pale grey-green linen dress, long fitted sleeves, bare feet, a damp shawl. She holds a smooth river stone. A calm faint smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long river-green coat-gown, wet-looking and shimmering, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a cape of flowing water-pattern cloth that parts around her; one flat stone floats just above her open palm. A faint thin halo of ripples.
art: A large close portrait, a calm grey face with damp hair against the cheek, eyes on a bridge outside the frame. Soft cool light from the left, a green water glint from the right. Foreground blur: drops and ripples.

name: 百锤之父卡尔德隆
who: Kalderon, the old god of the forge and anvil, walking the world as an old dwarf who drinks beside the furnace all day, 128 cm, broad and round-bellied, with a nose red from fire and wine. A great white beard singed at the tips, tiny bright eyes under bushy white eyebrows, burn scars on thick forearms. A wineskin that is never empty. Asked his name he says he has forgotten. He makes only nails, tosses them in a barrel, and every house of the forge city is held by them.
palette: forge orange, iron black, white beard, wine red
casual: A dwarf smith's thick leather apron pocked with spark holes over a stained wool shirt with rolled sleeves, short trousers and iron-shod boots, a leather skullcap, a wineskin on a strap; a small rust-red hammer at the belt, a handful of bright nails in one hand. Standing with a slight rolling stance.
private: Resting: a loose old wool shirt, braces, felt slippers, apron off. A full wineskin hugged to his chest, a nail turning in his fingers. A drowsy contented smile.
formal: As a god: a long dark red coat-robe with iron-grey trim, closing down the front with iron buttons, fitted sleeves, a heavy leather apron embossed with gold; the white beard bound with iron rings; a great hammer of black iron resting on his shoulder. A faint thin halo of orange sparks.
art: A large close portrait of the singed white beard and twinkling eyes, a nail held up to the lens. Hot orange furnace light from the left, a cool blue rim from the right. Foreground blur: flying sparks and a barrel of nails.

name: 断岭之怒提格蒙
who: Tigmon, the god of earthquakes, walking the world as a lean man of about fifty, 168 cm, walking so lightly that the ground does not tremble under his feet. A face marked with deep lines like cracks in dry ground, short grey hair, narrow brown eyes. He is quiet when angry; only a thin crack opens under his foot. He does not remember the god before him. Wary, spare, patient.
palette: dry earth brown, crack black, ash grey, rust
casual: A plain travelling coat of dry dust-brown wool closing down the front with wooden buttons, fitted sleeves, a rope belt, trousers and soft-soled boots, a flat cap. Hands clasped in front, standing very light on his feet.
private: Resting: a loose old shirt with the sleeves rolled, braces, soft shoes. He holds a small cracked clay cup in both hands. A tired thin smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of dark earth-brown wool with copper-red trim, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a high collar; a thin line of faint red-gold light running like a crack down the front of the coat and across the floor beneath him. A faint thin halo.
art: A large close portrait, the lined face with narrow brown eyes, a thin red-gold glow like a fissure rising behind. Dry yellow light from the left, a rust glow from the right. Foreground blur: dust motes and small stones lifting.

name: 城门的脊梁贝奥尔
who: Beor, the god of gates and the one who holds them, walking the world as a broad-shouldered gate warden of about forty-five, 195 cm, who is always standing with his back against something, one hand on a bolt. Short dark brown hair, a heavy plain face, steady dark eyes, a trimmed beard. Slow to speak and impossible to move. Dependable, immovable, with the look of one who has held the door many times.
palette: gate iron grey, oak brown, brass, torchlight amber
casual: A gate warden's thick brown wool coat with leather shoulder pads, closing down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves, a studded belt, heavy trousers and boots; a ring of large iron keys at the belt. One hand resting on a wooden bar-bolt at his side. Back straight, shoulders square.
private: Resting: a heavy knitted wool sweater, rolled sleeves, dark trousers, soft boots. Leaning back against a post, one hand around a mug, the keys set aside. A slow tired half smile.
formal: As a god: a long surcoat of dark iron-grey wool with gold gate-pattern embroidery, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a gold gorget; a heavy bar-bolt of iron and gold held upright in both hands in front of him. A bright broad thin halo of white light behind the head so strong the face is softened.
art: A large close portrait of the heavy plain face lit warm from one side, dark eyes steady. Warm torchlight amber from the left, a cold grey from the right. Foreground blur: the end of a gate bolt and sparks.

name: 地下的黑乌尔卡
who: Ulka, the god of caves and underground water, walking the world as a man of no clear age, about thirty-five, 172 cm, who sees well in the dark and poorly in strong light. Skin with a faint wet sheen like damp rock, grey-brown, dark hair plastered back, eyes that are two points of water-light. He does not carry a light and does not feel the cold. Quiet, careful, slow-blinking, always a little hunched toward shade.
palette: wet rock grey, cave black, water-light blue, damp brown
casual: A well-digger's long dark wool coat with a hooded collar, closing down the front with dark buttons, fitted sleeves, rope belt, trousers and soft-soled boots; a coil of rope and a wooden bucket on a cord at one shoulder. Standing at the edge of shadow, head slightly lowered.
private: Resting: a worn dark wool shirt with rolled sleeves, braces, soft felt shoes. Eyes shut, hands loosely folded. A faint peaceful smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of dark wet-looking slate wool with silver water-line trim, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a high collar; skin that glistens like cave stone; a pair of eyes glowing faintly like two points of water in darkness. A faint thin halo of cold blue-silver light.
art: A large close portrait, the face half in shadow, two points of pale water-light for eyes. Barely any light, a thin cold blue rim from the right. Foreground blur: dripping water and dark stone.

name: 刻名者塔尔姆
who: Talm, the god of inscriptions, walking the world as a lean tall old stonemason of about seventy, 186 cm, with fingers covered in stone dust and chisel scars. Grey cropped hair and a grey stubble beard, deep-set grey eyes, a patient, careful face. He stands in front of carved stones, and when a letter has worn shallow he runs his thumb over it to deepen it. He does not remember the god before him. Calm, quiet, exact.
palette: stone grey, chalk white, chisel steel, dust beige
casual: A stonemason's long grey linen smock over a dark wool shirt, closing down the front with plain buttons, fitted sleeves, a leather tool roll at the belt, trousers and heavy boots; hands and cuffs powdered with white stone dust. One hand holding a small chisel at his side. Standing before an unseen carved stone.
private: Resting: a worn brown cardigan over a grey shirt, soft shoes, stone dust in the folds. A small mallet and a chisel held loosely in one hand. A mild thoughtful smile.
formal: As a god: a long robe-coat of stone-grey wool with silver letter patterns embroidered like inscriptions down the front, closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves; a great chisel and mallet of dark metal held in both hands. A faint thin halo of floating pale letters. Nothing floats around him: no letters, runes or symbols in the air; the inscriptions are only chiselled into the coat hem.
art: A large close portrait, the deep-set grey eyes looking at a carved name, dust on his lashes. Soft grey side light from the left, warm lamp glow on the right. Foreground blur: falling stone chips and a half-carved slab.

name: 晨昏的司辰托纳修
who: Tonaxiu, the god of sunrise, sunset and the keeping of time, walking the world as a tall man of about thirty-five, 190 cm, travel-stained from the long road, hair the gold of straw, eyes like the morning sky. When people kneel to him he neither helps them up nor looks at them. Where he has stood, shadows are a little shorter. Distant, reserved, dignified.
palette: straw gold, morning sky blue, road dust brown, sun amber
casual: A traveller's long dust-brown wool coat, closing down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves, a leather belt, trousers and boots covered in road dust, a short cloak pinned at one shoulder. A cloth-wrapped bundle at his hip. Standing straight with his face turned to the horizon.
private: Resting: a loose pale wool shirt, sleeves rolled, dust-brown waistcoat, soft boots. A small golden disc turning in one hand. A distant quiet half smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of pale gold and white wool with sun-ray embroidery, closing down the front with gold buttons, fitted sleeves, a high collar; behind him a thin golden disc like a wheel; the reins of a golden chariot held loosely in one hand. A faint thin halo of gold.
art: A large close portrait, the straw-gold hair and the morning-blue eyes on the horizon, shadow short on the cheek. Gold low light from the right, soft blue shade on the left. Foreground blur: warm dust and a thin ray of light.

casual: A long coat of dust-brown wool, closing down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves, trousers and boots covered in road dust, a short cloak at one shoulder; a bundle at his hip. Standing straight with his face turned to the horizon.
private: Resting: a loose pale wool shirt, sleeves rolled, dust-brown waistcoat, soft boots. A small golden disc turning in one hand. A distant quiet half smile.

art: A large close portrait, the straw-gold hair and the morning-blue eyes on the horizon, shadow short on the cheek. Gold low light from the right, soft blue shade on the left. Foreground blur: warm dust and a thin ray of light.

name: 朝潮夕汐之主乌姆拉
who: Umra, the goddess of tides and deep water, who rarely takes human shape; when she does she is a tall silent woman of about forty, 180 cm, standing where the tide has just drawn back farther than it should. Long dark hair the colour of deep water, wet down her back, grey-green eyes with a deep slow gaze. The sea behind her draws back one step wherever she stands. Calm, vast, slow-moving.
palette: deep sea green, tide-line grey, foam white, deep blue
casual: A fisherwoman's long dark blue oilcloth coat, damp, closing down the front with horn toggles, fitted sleeves, a long wool skirt and high boots; a net draped over one shoulder. Standing at the edge of the wet sand, quiet, her face toward the water.
private: Resting: a loose grey wool dress with long sleeves, a knitted shawl, bare feet in the wet sand, the long dark hair unbound. She holds a shell to her ear. A faint dreamy smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long gown of deep sea green with foam-white lace trim, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a wide cape of wave-pattern cloth; her hair flowing as if underwater. A single large pearl in the hand. A faint thin halo of tide light.
art: A large close portrait, the deep grey-green eyes looking slowly at the viewer, damp hair across the cheek. Cold blue-green light from the left, a pearl glow from the right. Foreground blur: drops of water and a curl of foam.

name: 缀星塞勒诺
who: Celeno, the god of stars and the night sky, walking the world as a slender tall man of about twenty-eight, 183 cm, who always glances at the sky before looking at a person. Dark midnight-blue hair, silver eyes, ten fingertips that carry a faint glimmer. Pale, thoughtful, with a soft private smile. Dressed in the colour of night.
palette: midnight blue, silver, star white, indigo
casual: A long night-blue wool coat, closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a pale linen shirt and dark trousers, soft boots; fingertips that glimmer faintly. A thin silver needle tucked in the buttonhole. Tilting his head to look up.
private: Resting: a loose indigo linen shirt, sleeves rolled, dark waistcoat, soft shoes. A small silver needle and a thread of light between his fingers. A soft private smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of deep midnight blue with silver star-pattern embroidery, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a high collar and a long trailing cloak scattered with stars; a long silver needle trailing a thread of light between ten glimmering fingers. A faint thin halo of stars.
art: A large close portrait, the silver eyes lifted to the sky, ten fingertips glowing in the foreground. Cool blue starlight from the left, a faint silver rim on the right. Foreground blur: drifting star points and a thread of light.

name: 缀星塞勒诺

palette: midnight blue, silver, star white, indigo
casual: A plain grey wool coat with thread stripes sewn at the cuffs, elbows thinned, closing down the front with plain buttons, fitted sleeves, a lead plumb weight on a cord at his neck, thin soft-soled shoes; fingertips that glimmer faintly. Tilting his head to look up.
private: Resting: a loose indigo linen shirt, a canvas over-tunic undone, soft shoes. A small silver needle and a thread of light in his fingers. A soft private smile.

name: 灯芯与灰烬的女主人莉薇兰
who: Livilan, the goddess of lamps, walking the world as a thin tall woman of about fifty, 177 cm, whose hair looks as though a layer of ash has settled on it, and whose skirt hem is singed. Grey hair worn loose, hollow cheeks, amber eyes that look only at flames. She comes through a door without knocking and often speaks only half a sentence. Where she has passed, the lamp wicks never grow a crust. Terse, gaunt, intense.
palette: ash grey, flame amber, soot black, singed brown
casual: A long dark grey wool coat-dress with a scorched hem, closing down the front with small horn buttons, fitted sleeves, a black apron, sturdy boots; a small tin lantern with a steady small flame held in one hand. Ash-grey hair loose. Standing still and looking at the flame.
private: Resting: a loose faded grey wool dress with long sleeves, a shawl with a burnt corner, soft shoes. She cups a candle flame in her hands and watches it. A faint distracted smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long ash-grey and dull-gold coat-gown with a scorched, glowing hem, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a high collar; a lantern of black iron and gold in one raised hand, the flame white and perfectly straight. A faint thin halo of warm amber.
art: A large close portrait, the gaunt face lit from below by a single steady flame, amber eyes fixed on it. Warm amber light from below, dark soot around. Foreground blur: a candle flame and drifting ash flakes.

name: 暴雨之王伊斯卡图
who: Iskatu, the god of thunder and storm rain, walking the world as a tall man of about thirty-eight, 189 cm, barefoot, with hair that crackles with faint static. Dark hair swept back, pale eyes, a lean angular face with a restless smile. Just before the thunder falls he lifts one hand. Restless, proud, electric, impatient.
palette: storm grey, lightning white, rain blue, wet dark brown
casual: A long dark wool storm coat with the collar up, damp, closing down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves, trousers, and wet leather sandals on bare feet; a rolled leather whip coiled at his belt. One hand half raised, as if about to call down the thunder. Rain beading on his shoulders.
private: Resting: a loose damp linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, trousers rolled at the ankle, bare feet. He holds a glass of water in which a small flash of lightning flickers. A restless crooked smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of dark blue-grey wool with silver lightning embroidery, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a high collar; a coiled whip of white lightning in one hand, hair crackling upright with static. A faint thin halo of pale blue light.
art: A large close portrait, wet dark hair, pale eyes catching a flash, a sharp smile. A white-blue flash from the left, deep grey from the right. Foreground blur: raindrops and a spark of static.

name: 霜息卡因霖
who: Cainlin, the goddess of frost and winter, walking the world as a tall woman of about thirty-five, 182 cm, a silver merchant wrapped in white fox fur. Hair white with a green-blue tinge, eyes the pale blue of the ice underneath, frost on her eyelashes in every season. She goes quietly through the crystal woods and the sound of the woods changes pitch as she passes. She does not remember the goddess before her. Cool, precise, calm.
palette: frost white, ice blue, silver, white fox fur
casual: A long coat of white fox fur trimmed with silver thread, closing down the front with silver hooks, fitted sleeves, a grey wool dress beneath, tall fur boots and fur-lined gloves; a leather satchel of silver bars at her hip. Frost on her lashes. Standing calm and poised.
private: Resting: a thick knitted pale-blue wool dress with long sleeves, a white shawl, fur-lined slippers, the pale hair loose. A steaming mug in both hands, the steam freezing into a few tiny crystals. A faint cool smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long gown of pale ice-blue and white, closing down the front with silver clasps, fitted sleeves, a trailing fur-edged cape; the hair streaming with frost, breath turning to a thin glittering mist. A faint thin halo of snow crystals. Western tailoring: plain round buttons in a straight row or lacing, no frog-knot fasteners, no knotted closures and no mandarin collar.
art: A large close portrait, a calm pale face with frosted lashes, pale ice-blue eyes. Cold blue-white light from the left, a silver rim on the right. Foreground blur: drifting snowflakes and breath mist.

name: 燧石与初火皮尔坎
who: Pilcan, the god of tinder and the first fire, walking the world as a thin young man of about twenty-four, 174 cm, with fingertips always black. His hair is dark red at the roots and gold at the tips, like a flame just taking. A flint hangs at his belt; he kneels at any cold hearth and a single stroke lights it. Cheerful, quick, kind to small things, always crouching by someone's stove.
palette: ember red, flame gold, soot black, flint grey
casual: A plain brown wool jacket closing down the front with wooden buttons, fitted sleeves, a linen shirt, trousers and worn boots; a flint and steel on a leather cord at his belt, sooty fingertips. A small bundle of kindling under one arm. Mid-crouch, hand reaching for a cold hearth.
private: Resting: a loose undershirt with rolled sleeves, soft shoes, hair rumpled. He holds a small flame in his open palm like a bird. A sleepy smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of deep red and black wool with gold trim, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a gold flint at the belt; hair burning from dark red to bright gold, a small steady flame hovering above one open hand. A faint thin halo of embers. Western tailoring: plain round buttons in a straight row or lacing, no frog-knot fasteners, no knotted closures and no mandarin collar.
art: A large close portrait, a boyish grin lit from below by a small flame in a cupped hand, hair red to gold. Warm orange light from below, a cool blue edge from behind. Foreground blur: floating sparks and a flint.

name: 真名之钥卡兰提尔
who: Calantir, the god of true names, walking the world as a slim middle-aged scholar of about forty-five, 178 cm, who speaks very slowly. Hair the pale yellow of old book pages, deep violet eyes. When he says a name, the keys and brass buttons on that person's clothes ring softly. A tall thin face, a patient manner, long fingers marked by quill ink. Gentle, grave, deliberate.
palette: old page yellow, deep violet, ink black, brass
casual: A scholar's long dark grey coat, closing down the front with brass buttons, fitted sleeves, ink-stained cuffs, a white collar, dark trousers and polished shoes; a heavy iron key on a cord at his neck. A slim book under one arm. Standing still, gently inclined.
private: Resting: a soft woollen dressing coat over a pale shirt, slippers, hair loosened. He holds a quill and a half-written page. A mild, faraway smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of deep violet and cream wool with gold key-pattern embroidery, closing down the front with gold buttons, fitted sleeves, a high collar; a giant ornate key of silver and gold held upright in one hand. A faint thin halo of pale glowing letters.
art: A large close portrait, the pale-yellow hair and deep violet eyes, a quill held near the lens. Warm lamp light from the left, a cool violet rim on the right. Foreground blur: floating pale letters and an old page edge.

name: 照影的少年神弥拉德
who: Miraded, the god of mirrors and reflections, walking the world as a strikingly handsome young man of about twenty-four, 180 cm, almost too beautiful to be real. Hair of a dark blue-green like deep water, eyes with a layer of water-shine in them that reflects whoever looks. His reflection in any water matches him exactly, even in the blink. Graceful, a little vain, fond of seeing himself seen.
palette: deep water teal, silver mirror, pale skin, midnight
casual: A well-cut short deep-blue wool jacket with silver buttons, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a white linen shirt with a high collar, tailored dark trousers and polished boots; a small round silver hand-mirror in one hand. Standing in an easy, self-aware pose.
private: Resting: an open-collar pale grey shirt, sleeves rolled, dark trousers, soft shoes. He looks into a hand-mirror with a half smile. Relaxed.
formal: As a god: a long coat of pale silver and deep teal with mirror-chip embroidery, closing down the front with silver clasps, fitted sleeves, a tall collar; a large round mirror floating beside him showing the same figure a blink late. A faint thin halo of water light.

name: 照影的少年神弥拉德
who: Miraded, the god of mirrors and reflections, walking the world as a strikingly handsome young man of about twenty-four, 180 cm, almost too beautiful to be real. Hair of a dark blue-green like deep water, eyes with a layer of water-shine in them that reflects whoever looks. His reflection in any water matches him exactly, even in the blink. Graceful, a little vain, fond of seeing himself seen.

name: 长夜之梦的牧人欧墨伦
who: Omeren, the god of dreams and omens, walking the world as a very old man of about eighty, 172 cm, slightly stooped, whose eyes are always half closed as if dozing, yet who knows who passes. A weathered face, wispy white hair, a grey beard. He appears as a night watchman or an old shepherd; sheep bells sound wherever he walks and no sheep are seen. Slow, sleepy, shrewd.
palette: dusk grey, wool white, lantern amber, midnight blue
casual: An old shepherd's long grey wool coat with the hood down, closing down the front with horn toggles, fitted sleeves, a rope belt, patched trousers and old boots; a crook of dark wood in one hand and a small copper bell on his belt. Half-closed eyes, stooped.
private: Resting: a soft knitted brown cardigan over a linen shirt, a blanket over one shoulder, felt slippers. He holds a small oil lamp and his eyes are closed. A drowsy smile.
formal: As a god: a long coat of deep midnight blue and silver-grey wool with a pattern of drifting stars, closing down the front, fitted sleeves, a long hooded cape; a crook of pale wood wound with a skein of silver thread. A faint thin halo of drifting dream-light.
art: A large close portrait, the old half-closed eyes, wispy hair, a soft drowsy smile. Dim lantern amber from the left, faint blue starlight on the right. Foreground blur: drifting pale threads and a small sheep bell.

name: 千结之绳奥兹米尔
who: Ozmir, the goddess of riddles and the shape of things, walking the world as a small woman of no certain age, about thirty, 152 cm, her braid tied off at the tip with a knot. Her two hands are always working at a rope covered in knots; each time she undoes one another appears. Bright dark eyes, quick fingers, an amused curious face. Any object put in her hands she turns over once and knows its true shape. Playful, sharp, curious.
palette: rope beige, dark brown, knot white, deep teal
casual: A neat short dark wool jacket with many small pockets, closing down the front with rope-toggle buttons, fitted sleeves, a skirt to the knee with stockings and boots, a long braid with a knot at its tip; a long knotted rope in her hands. Tilting her head, fingers busy. Western tailoring: plain round buttons in a straight row or lacing, no frog-knot fasteners, no knotted closures and no mandarin collar. The rope knots appear only in her hands, never on her clothes.
private: Resting: a loose wool cardigan over a linen shirt, soft shoes, the braid undone for once. She holds the knotted rope up to her face and squints at it. An amused half smile.
formal: As a goddess: a long coat-gown of deep teal and cream with rope-knot embroidery, closing down the front with knot buttons, fitted sleeves; the long knotted rope spilling from her hands and curling around her like a living thing. A faint thin halo of glowing knots. Western tailoring: plain round buttons in a straight row or lacing, no frog-knot fasteners, no knotted closures and no mandarin collar. The rope knots appear only in her hands, never on her clothes.
art: A large close portrait, bright dark eyes, a knot at the tip of the braid, a knotted rope held near the lens. Warm lamp light from the right, a cool teal shade on the left. Foreground blur: loose rope ends and floating knots.
